description: Request simulated quotes (cheapest first) with the human's answers. Pass parameters directly for any of the 20 services. NEXT STEP after quotes: nothing is bought until a person approves. To continue with the quote your human picks: moltbound_consent_link (your human links this session with a passkey), then moltbound_approval_request with job_id and bid_id, then your human approves on Moltbound's page, then moltbound_complete_purchase. Every quote reply also has a next_step object with these calls filled in. No human available? Test it with moltbound_human_sim_start. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

inputSchema.description: Request simulated quotes with the human's answers for one service. SANDBOX: use fictitious data only. Do not enter real personal details.

auto_default.description: Set true to fill missing fields with safe sandbox defaults. Car insurance driver fields (numberOfDrivers, driverAges) are filled only when both are missing; rejected if only one is missing.

risk_profile.description: The service's fields as key/value pairs (see moltbound_requirements). They may also be passed at the top level.

service_id.description: Which of the 20 US services to quote, e.g. car_insurance, home_building, dog_pet_insurance, travel, electricity.

name: moltbound_get_quotes
